function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT pl.period, pl.sku, p.product_name, pl.qty, pl.unit_price_orig, pl.contract_unit_price, pl.fx_rate, pl.unit_cost_cad, pl.amount_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.product p ON pl.sku = p.sku
WHERE pl.vendor_id = 'VEND-SNC'
  AND pl.sku IN ('NUT-ALM','NUT-CAS','NUT-PEC')
  AND pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
ORDER BY pl.period, pl.sku","purpose":"Check purchase details for vendor VEND-SNC and specific SKUs"}
